en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, fom Tahir who said,

‘I was in the presence of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> kissed Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This one<sup>asws</sup> is the best of the Created beings, or (even) better’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Tahir who has said the following.
“Once I was in the presence of abu Ja‘far (a.s.) when Ja‘far (a.s.) came. Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) said, “This (Ja‘far ) is the best of the people or the best of best among them.”
